label: Blind sample null 094: intact forest, no Hansen loss 2001-2023, tile 00N_060W

verdict.headline: Can't tell
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.03 relative to the control trajectory in the 18 months after 1 Jan 2018 (90% interval −0.08 to −0.00). The same test was run on 16 untouched control cells. In 5 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.35). Counted by gap size instead, 2 of the 16 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.18). But: only 16 usable control cells (need 20); only 10 clear observation periods before the event (need 20).
reasons: only 10 clear observation periods before the event (need 20)

evidence.sentence: Neither optical nor radar shows a change beyond what the controls did.
